title: quantityDeclarationResponseData
description: Quantity declaration response context containing the network location, internal balancing group, covered period and response time series.

internalAccount.description: Internal balancing group identifier for which the response is provided.

period.description: Period covered by the quantity declaration response, represented as an ISO 8601 interval or duration expression.

timeSeries.description: Response time series for the specified location, balancing group and period.
